changes: When the loop gets longer, the quick perf rec repeats over the new steps at the take's own period, once, at the length change; a shorter loop cuts the take to its start only after a whole pass has played at it. A QPER knob take follows a longer loop to its new end and ends when the loop is cut short of it. 16,233 to 16,553 bytes of RAM; the idle quick exit is unchanged.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
